current: Spletne strani lahko zahtevajo vašo lokacijo.
rationale: en-US says "Websites you visit may request your location"; the qualifier "you visit" is omitted.
suggest: Spletne strani, ki jih obiščete, lahko zahtevajo vašo lokacijo.
summary: The translation drops "you visit" from the source.

rationale: NSCameraUsageDescription in the same file uses "kode QR"; the same term should be consistent within the screen/file.
summary: "QR code" is rendered inconsistently with the other InfoPlist string that uses "kode QR".

rationale: Source is "Select the %@ app icon"; %@ is the app name. Appending an inflectional "a" directly to the placeholder produces forms like "Firefoxa" glued to the substituted brand string, altering the brand name and breaking for other app names (e.g. Klar, Focus).
summary: The placeholder (app name, e.g. "Firefox") is given a suffixed genitive ending "-a", which mangles the brand name in the accessibility hint.

rationale: The source uses curly quotes “%@”; the translation uses straight ASCII quotes, inconsistent with the other toast strings in the same file which keep typographic quotes.
summary: Straight ASCII quotes used instead of the typographic quotes of the source.

current: Piškotki in podatki spletnega mesta odstranjeni
rationale: The same source term "site data" appears in AlertTitle, ButtonTitle and AlertText as "podatki strani"; the toast uses a different rendering on the same screen.
summary: "site data" is rendered as "podatki spletnega mesta" here but as "podatki strani" in the other clear-data strings on the same screen.

rationale: The source's idiom means protections are currently paused/off-duty; the target asserts the app does not protect you at all.
summary: "%@ is off-duty" rendered as "%@ does not protect you".

rationale: The source asks for a valid expiration date, not just the year.
summary: "expiration date" translated as "leto poteka" (expiration year).

current: Želite odpreti privzeto aplikacijo za e-pošto?
rationale: The object of "open" in the source is the email, opened in the default mail application; the target drops the email.
suggest: Želite odpreti e-pošto v privzeti aplikaciji za e-pošto?
summary: Translation says "Open the default email application?" instead of "Open email in the default mail application?".

current: Želite odpreti zunanjo aplikacijo za sporočila?
rationale: The source opens the SMS in an external app; the target drops the SMS object.
suggest: Želite odpreti SMS v zunanji aplikaciji?
summary: Translation says "Open an external application for messages?" instead of "Open sms in an external application?".

rationale: Per the developer comment %1$@ is the app name (e.g. Firefox) and %2$@ is the number of tabs; the Slovenian places the app name where a number belongs ("Zaprtih Firefox zavihkov: 5"), producing nonsense.
summary: The two placeholders are swapped in meaning: %1$@ is the app name and %2$@ the tab count, but the translation reads as if %1$@ were the number.

rationale: The en-US source uses curly quotes “%@”; the Slovenian uses straight ASCII double quotes, deviating from the source typography.
summary: Straight ASCII quotes used instead of the typographic quotation marks of the source.

rationale: The source says it takes seconds (a few seconds), not one second.
summary: "Takes seconds" (plural) is rendered as singular "Vzame vam sekundo" (takes one second).

rationale: Slovenian orthography writes indefinite pronoun/adverb + koli separately: 'kadar koli'.
summary: "Kadarkoli" should be written as two words in standard Slovenian.

rationale: Within the same Tools section, MainMenu.ToolsSection.SwitchToDesktopSite.Title.v131 and its accessibility label translate "desktop site" as "stran za računalnike"; this string uses a different term for the same source concept.
summary: "Desktop Site" is rendered as "Stran za namizja" while the parallel switch actions in the same menu use "stran za računalnike".

rationale: %@ is substituted with the app name verbatim; appending a case ending to a placeholder is not valid and yields wrong output for names that do not take -a (e.g. Focus, Klar).
summary: The declension suffix "a" is appended directly to the app-name placeholder, producing an incorrect form such as "Logotip Firefoxa" only by chance and breaking for other app names.

rationale: En-US "For good." in this Mozilla context means acting for good/benefit, not 'permanently'; "Za vedno" reverses the sense to a time expression.
summary: "For good" (meaning 'for the benefit of all / for good causes') is rendered as "Za vedno" ("forever").

rationale: The source says only "%2$@’s marketing partners"; "tehnološkim" (technology) adds content that is not in the English string.
summary: "marketing partners" is translated as "tehnološkim partnerjem ... za trženje", introducing "technology" which is not in the source.

rationale: Source is "Manage settings", a link that takes the user to manage data collection preferences; the translation says just "Settings".
summary: "Manage settings" is rendered only as "Nastavitve", dropping the "manage" action.

rationale: The en-US v149 title adds "all" ("Open all your links") compared to the v2 title; the translation omits it.
suggest: Odpirajte vse povezave z vgrajeno zasebnostjo
summary: The word "all" from "Open all your links" is dropped, making it identical to the v2 string.

current: se sinhronizirajo s katerokoli drugo napravo
rationale: The source says your bookmarks and passwords sync on any device (they are available on all devices), not that they sync with some other single device.
suggest: se sinhronizirajo na vseh vaših napravah
summary: "sync on any device" is rendered as syncing "with any other device", changing the meaning.

current: ki ji zaupate že več kot 20 let
rationale: The source states the non-profit has been trusted (by people generally) for over 20 years; the translation asserts the individual user has trusted it for 20 years.
suggest: ki ji ljudje zaupajo že več kot 20 let
summary: "trusted for over 20 years" is translated as "which you have trusted for over 20 years", addressing the individual user instead of general trust.

rationale: The source is "Manage settings", a link to manage data collection preferences; the translation omits "Manage".
summary: "Manage settings" is translated only as "Nastavitve" (Settings), dropping the verb.

rationale: The source says the data helps improve features, performance and stability "for everyone", not "for users all over the world", which adds meaning not present in the en-US text.
summary: "for everyone" is mistranslated as "for users all over the world".

rationale: Source is "Limited Edition Wallpaper"; the sibling string "Classic Wallpaper" is translated as "Klasično ozadje", so this accessibility label should also state that it is a wallpaper.
summary: Accessibility label drops the word "Wallpaper" present in the source and in the parallel Classic string.

rationale: In Firefox Slovenian the term for "Fingerprinters" is "Sledilci prstnih odtisov naprav"; the shortened form loses the meaning of device fingerprinting.
summary: "Fingerprinters" is rendered as "Sledilci prstnih odtisov" (trackers of fingerprints) instead of the established Slovenian term for fingerprinting scripts.

rationale: The developer comment states %@ is the app name (e.g. Firefox); the source asks permission for the app to open a URL. The Slovenian reads as permission to open the app itself.
summary: The translation reverses the roles: it says "Allow opening of %@" instead of allowing the app (%@) to open the URL.

current: Morebitni modeli UI, ki so se že prenesli na napravo, bodo odstranjeni.
rationale: The en-US restricts model removal to on-device AI ("For on-device AI, any downloaded models are removed."); the translation omits this condition.
suggest: Pri UI, ki teče na napravi, bodo odstranjeni vsi preneseni modeli.
summary: The qualifier "For on-device AI" is dropped, changing the scope of the second sentence.

current: Določene možnosti lahko posebej omogočite spodaj.
rationale: Source says to unblock specific features; the section otherwise uses "prepoved/prepovedano" terminology, so "omogočite" is inconsistent with the block/unblock wording.
suggest: Prepoved za posamezne možnosti lahko odpravite spodaj.
summary: "Unblock specific features below" is rendered as "omogočite" (enable) losing the unblock sense and the wording adds "posebej".

current: bo izboljševal zmogljivosti, zanesljivost in učinkovitost delovanja med posodobitvami
rationale: en-US lists features, performance and stability; the translation omits "features" and renders the remaining items inaccurately.
suggest: bo izboljševal funkcije, zmogljivost in stabilnost med posodobitvami
summary: The list "features, performance, and stability" is mistranslated; "features" is dropped and replaced by duplicated performance terms.

current: Podrsajte, da skrijete vrstico z zavihki in naslovom
rationale: The source is a settings option title ("Scroll to Hide Tab and Address Bar"), a label rather than an instruction addressed to the user; it also conflates the tab bar and address bar into one bar.
suggest: Drsenje skrije vrstico z zavihki in naslovno vrstico
summary: Setting title translated as an imperative sentence instead of a noun-phrase label.

rationale: The source refers to browsing history (zgodovina brskanja), not search history (zgodovina iskanja).
summary: "Search Browsing History" is rendered as "search history" instead of "browsing history".

rationale: Elsewhere in this same file "features" is translated as "funkcije" (e.g. Settings.Studies.Message.v136 "Preizkusite funkcije in ideje"); "značilnosti" is inconsistent and misleading here.
summary: "Feature Studies" is rendered as "raziskave značilnosti" instead of the established term for features ("funkcije").

current: Potresite napravo, da povzamete vsebino strani.
rationale: en-US says "Shake your device from side to side"; the manner of the gesture is omitted in the translation.
suggest: Napravo potresite z ene strani na drugo, da povzamete vsebino strani.
summary: The detail "from side to side" is dropped from the shake gesture description.

current: Samodejno prevede strani v vaš izbrani jezik.
rationale: The source refers to the first/top language in the Preferred Languages list, not just any selected language.
suggest: Samodejno prevede strani v vaš najbolj prednostni jezik.
summary: "your top preferred language" is translated as merely "vaš izbrani jezik", losing the notion of the highest-ranked preferred language.

rationale: en-US "Spread the word about %1$@" means to tell others about the app; "širite besedo" is a literal word-for-word calque that does not carry that meaning in Slovenian.
summary: "Spread the word" is rendered as the literal calque "Širite besedo", which is not idiomatic Slovenian and does not convey the meaning.

rationale: en-US "Can’t handle this one at the moment." is impersonal; the Slovenian introduces a first-person "I can't", a register the app does not use elsewhere.
summary: The translation uses a first-person anthropomorphic voice ("ne morem narediti") absent from the source and against product register.

current: Poskusite znova za povzetek spletne strani
rationale: The visible button label (Summarizer.RetryButton.Label.v142) is "Poskusi znova"; the accessibility label for the same control should use the same imperative form for consistency.
summary: The a11y label for the retry button uses a second-person plural imperative addressed to the user instead of an action label matching the button's own action.

rationale: The menu items follow "Zapri zavihke, starejše od …", so the correct genitive singular is "enega dne"/"1 dneva" is wrong agreement with numeral 1; as a standalone label it should read "1 dan" (or "pred 1 dnevom").
summary: "1 Day Ago" is rendered as "1 dneva", which is ungrammatical and drops the meaning of the time reference.

rationale: Slovenian typography requires an en dash (–) with spaces for parenthetical/appositive dashes, not a hyphen.
summary: Hyphen used instead of an en dash as a sentence-level dash.

rationale: The source refers to searching for a single image (the one right-clicked), not images in general.
summary: Singular "Search Image" rendered as plural "Išči slike".

current: Zapri izbirnik držav na svetovnem prvenstvu

rationale: The source says only "Please refresh." without specifying the widget; the added noun changes the instruction's content.

rationale: The source "Hide World Cup updates" refers to updates/news, not generic data.

rationale: The en-US source is "This Connection is Untrusted", which is about trust, not privacy.

rationale: Slovenian does not capitalize the common noun mid-phrase, and the standard rendering of "Firefox Account" is "Račun Firefox".

rationale: The source says "Firefox logo"; the Slovenian word is "logotip", not "Logtip".

rationale: In Slovenian the noun follows the brand name; "Firefox Računom" is an English word-order calque with wrong capitalization of the common noun.

current: Niste prijavljeni v vaš Firefox Račun.
